correctness.rationale: PASS: The bipartition of Q5 has sixteen vertices on each side, every selected vertex has five neighbors, hence every total dominating set needs >=4 selected even and >=4 selected odd vertices. Independent enumeration of all C(16,4)=1820 parity-side four-subsets found exactly 40 coverings; the same 40 are precisely the four-cycles of 5-regular distance-four Clebsch graph, confirming the source analytic weight-0/2/4 classification. Therefore minimum size eight with exactly 40²=1600 configurations. Clebsch four-cycles share no three vertices, so there are no legal one-replacement edges. Two-replacement moves cannot split among parities and correspond to edge-sharing quadrangles on one factor, giving R2=H Cartesian H. Independent reconstruction of all H edges via direct intersection of the 40 four-subsets found 240 edges, valency 12, every vertex distance histogram (1,12,27) and diameter two. Cartesian product then has 1600 vertices, 24-regular, 19200 edges, diameter four, profile (1,24,198,648,729). This fresh 1820-subset and 780-pair computation checks the exact finite certificate; it is not a partial random sample. The supplied separate direct-Q5 C++ exhaustive tester was inspected but its asserted exit output was not treated as additional independent execution.
